name: credit-card-warning
description: A complete payment card and stripe beside an exclamation mark.
useCase: Show a payment-card warning with an explanatory label.
misuse: Use accompanying text for the payment status and next step.

16.reason: A taller exclamation moves right to retain a clear stem and dot beside the full card.

24.reason: The complete exclamation has a longer stem; its rightward placement leaves clear space around the card.
